fields.notes: CANopen's protocol-level DFT surface is the SDO-readable object dictionary, the EMCY emergency object + pre-defined error field (0x1003), the error register (0x1001), heartbeat / node-guarding liveness, and LSS for Node-ID / bit-timing setup. Frame-level error handling is the CAN data link layer beneath CANopen. Chip-level JTAG / scan / BIST remain controller-vendor / SoC-integrator concerns; conformance is established by CiA conformance testing.

in_band_test_facilities.name: SDO object-dictionary readback
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Read every supported OD entry by index/sub-index to verify the device against its EDS.

in_band_test_facilities.name: EMCY + pre-defined error field (0x1003)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Error history and active error observability.

in_band_test_facilities.name: LSS (CiA 305)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Inquire / assign Node-ID and bit-timing over the bus.

out_of_band_test_facilities: CiA conformance testing for CANopen devices.
Underlying CAN data-link error counters / bus monitoring (implementation-defined CAN controller).
